steps.note: Hotlap, Time Trial, Practice or a race: AC's telemetry server only exists while you are on track, so the stream starts within a few seconds of being on track, not in the menus

extras.label: Probe once, on track (Terminal on this Mac, in ~/Projects/pitwall)
extras.value: uv run python scripts/probe_ac.py --ip <PS5 IP> --platform ps5 --seconds 60 --out ~/ac-probe-ps5.pwcap
extras.note: only to diagnose a console that does not stream. Switch the Assetto Corsa integration Off on this page while the probe runs (two registrations would make the stream look unstable). It sends at most 5 handshakes to the console and records what comes back. Exit code 0 = it streams

notes: PS5 (PS4 version): a probe on 2026-10-11 confirmed that the game answers and streams at 60 Hz, and pitwall decodes that recording, lap time included (one lap). pitwall's own connection, lap storage and coaching are still to be confirmed on a full AC session. Also community-confirmed on PS4 and PC.

Connect page status: 'refused' = the console answered but nothing listens on 9996: AC is not on track yet (menus, loading); 'handshaking' with no reply = not on track, wrong IP, or Wi-Fi client isolation (try wired).

Lap distance needs the start/finish line and the track length: on a new track the out-lap has none, the length is estimated 15-25 % of a lap after the first crossing and fixed by the first full lap - the laps before that are not used as references. Tracks driven before have distance from the first metre. The console does not say which layout of a track is loaded: layouts are told apart by length. Steering, tyre temperatures, fuel and sectors are not sent by the game.
Going back to the pits with a lap-counter reset (or restarting) starts a new session; a lap whose state the game restores afterwards is not counted twice.
